{"title":"Texas (Austin/Dallas/Houston) investor pipeline: targets + outreach + Sheets CRM + cadence","content":"## Objective
Stand up an operational investor pipeline by mid-January for a $2.4M remaining raise for an East Austin boutique hotel + restaurant/cocktail bar.

## Strategy (parallel workstreams → one integrated system)
1) Build a Texas-first target universe (angels, hospitality/real estate investors, community investors, and high-leverage connectors) with contact paths and prioritization.
2) Produce outreach assets (cold + warm intro requests + follow-up sequences) tailored to hospitality/real-estate flavored raises.
3) Implement a lightweight Google Sheets CRM that enforces weekly throughput (3 meetings/week Tue–Thu) with clear stages, next actions, and reporting.
4) Synthesize into a single operating cadence: daily/weekly actions, meeting prep, and follow-up SLAs.

## Deliverables
- Curated investor + connector list (TX focus; optional CO add-on column) with segmentation and first-approach guidance
- Outreach templates + follow-up sequences + short “one-liner / blurb” variants for forwarding
- Google Sheets CRM template spec (tabs/columns/formulas) + usage SOP
- Weekly meeting cadence + KPI targets to ensure enough shots-on-goal before mid-January
